title: Tournament-only venues and saving venues for reuse
description: A venue you add to a tournament belongs to that tournament unless you tick Save for future tournaments. Who can add one, who can edit one, and where each kind shows up.
body:
A venue you add while setting up a tournament is used by that tournament only, unless you tick Save for future tournaments. A saved venue is offered again the next time you create a tournament, and it carries a Saved badge wherever it is listed.

Before you start

The tournament's Owner and its Admins can add venues to it. Only the account that added a venue can edit it. The Owner cannot edit a venue an Admin added, and an Admin cannot edit the Owner's. A venue cannot be taken off a tournament once it is on it.

Choosing or adding a venue when you create a tournament

  1. Select New Tournament and open Create or Select Clubs. Your saved tournament venues are listed. Tick the ones this tournament will use.

  2. To add a venue that is not listed, select the + at the top of the list. Type the Club name and the Location.
  3. Tick Save for future tournaments if you will use this venue again. Leave it unticked for a one-off venue.

  4. Select Continue. The venue is added to the list and ticked for this tournament.

The list here shows saved tournament venues only. The venues you use for ordinary matches are a separate list and do not appear. See Venues - adding, finding, editing and logos.

Venues on an existing tournament

  1. Open the tournament's Settings and scroll to LOCATION. Every venue on the tournament is listed, whoever added it. The Saved badge marks the ones kept for reuse.

  2. Select + Location to add another venue. The same form opens, with the Save for future tournaments box.
  3. To change a venue you added, select the three dots on its row and choose Edit. There is no Remove.

A venue can also be added from the fixture dialog when you schedule a group. See Bulk-scheduling a football group, and the gap between matches.

What an Admin can and cannot do

An Admin sees the same LOCATION card as the Owner and can add venues with + Location. Editing a venue somebody else added is refused.

  1. As an Admin, select Edit on a venue the Owner added and change a field.
  2. Select Continue. The form stays open and shows Club location can only be modified by its creator. Nothing is saved.

Where each kind of venue shows up

  • Tournament-only venue, added with the Save box unticked: on that tournament, and nowhere else. It is not in Profile settings, not on match forms, and not offered to your next tournament.
  • Saved tournament venue, added with the Save box ticked: on the tournament, in the Create Tournament list for your next tournament, and in Profile settings with the Saved badge.
  • Match venue, added from Profile settings or a match form: on match forms and in Profile settings. Not offered for tournaments.

Either way, everybody can see where a tournament is played. Its public Info tab counts the venues under NO. OF LOCATIONS and names each one, whoever added it.

If it does not work

  • You cannot edit a venue on your own tournament. An Admin added it. Ask them, or add your own venue with + Location.
  • A venue you added last time is not in the Create Tournament list. The Save for future tournaments box was unticked, so it belongs to that tournament only. Add it again and tick the box.
  • You want to take a venue off the tournament. Edit it to a venue you will use instead, or leave it unused when you schedule fixtures.
  • Settings will not open, and you land on the tournament page instead. You are not its Owner or an Admin, so the app sends you to the public Info tab. Ask the Owner to add you as an Admin. See You do not have permission to do that.
